key_highlights: ASX inches higher on energy and big miner rally, but gains modest amid broader macro uncertainty
Iron ore weakness pressures BHP; company reportedly mulling strategic options as commodity price crumbles
Australian housing price falls accelerate dramatically; RBA signals it will not intervene to rescue property market
Property industry described as facing its 'GFC moment' with accelerating corrections
Consumer stress intensifies: mortgage costs driving second jobs, 104-year-old beauty chain closes hundreds of salons
Gold sector active: Forrestania joins 2Moz club, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory, Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M
BYD declares Australia has passed EV tipping point, signalling structural shift for automotive and energy sectors
China oil imports rebound, supporting crude prices; tanker wars assessed as insufficient to suppress oil
Qantas engine flame incident diverts Sydney-bound flight, raising safety scrutiny
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network, consolidating media ownership

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness pressures BHP and peers, but gold miners show strength with multiple discoveries and acquisitions. Energy stocks rally on oil rebound.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX faces strategic uncertainty as iron ore crumbles; gold names (FOR.AX, KAL.AX, AUK.AX, LRV.AX) benefit from sector rotation. Energy (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) supported by China import recovery.

sectors.trend: Housing price falls accelerate; RBA explicitly rules out rescue. Mortgage stress driving consumer distress. Property sector faces GFC-level correction.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPL risk from property exposure. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure. RBA inaction limits rate-cut catalyst.

sectors.trend: Consumer squeeze intensifies: second jobs, beauty chain closures, retail store closures (Gap 350 stores). Affordability crisis deepening.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, LSG.AX face margin pressure. Discretionary spend under threat. Insurance premiums rising on vehicle supply crunch.

sectors.trend: BYD declares Australia EV tipping point passed. Oil supported by China import rebound. Tanker wars not enough to spike prices further.
sectors.implications: EV adoption accelerates, pressuring traditional auto and fuel demand long-term. Short-term oil support benefits WDS.AX, WLE.AX. Infrastructure arbitrage opportunities in power market.

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control. AI regulation debates (US) create uncertainty. TSMC raises guidance on chip demand.
sectors.implications: Media consolidation under Stokes (SOL.AX exposure). Global tech strength (TSM) supports sentiment but AI regulation risk looms.

key_themes: Housing correction accelerates with RBA inaction – structural risk to financials and REITs
Iron ore weakness vs gold strength – commodity rotation within materials
Consumer affordability crisis deepening across retail and services
EV transition inflection point in Australia
Geopolitical fragmentation: Russia-Germany spat, tanker tensions, El Nino
Qantas safety incident raises airline sector scrutiny

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property-linked financial exposure; favour cash-rich banks with diversified lending (CBA.AX, NAB.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse pressuring BHP and miners
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate from iron ore exposure to gold and energy; monitor BHP strategic options

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand contraction from mortgage stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WPG.AX) over discretionary; monitor retail sales data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Russia-Germany, tanker wars, El Nino)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy and gold hedges; monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas safety incident and airline sector risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor QAN.AX for regulatory response; limited systemic impact

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on sector rotation from iron ore
opportunities.rationale: Multiple discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie, Aureka acquisition) signal sector strength; gold benefits from geopolitical uncertainty and RBA inaction

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on China oil import rebound
opportunities.rationale: Crude supported by China demand recovery; tanker wars add tail risk upside; tanker wars won't suppress oil per analysis

opportunities.recommendation: Position for EV infrastructure and power market arbitrage
opportunities.rationale: BYD confirms Australia EV tipping point; load growth and infrastructure gaps create multi-year opportunity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property and REIT exposure; trim iron ore overweight
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing GFC moment with RBA inaction; iron ore structural weakness pressuring BHP

defensive_moves.recommendation: Favour defensive consumer staples and cash
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer squeeze from mortgage costs; retail closures signal demand weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain AUD/USD hedge given geopolitical risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Russia-Germany spat, tanker tensions, El Nino create volatility; AUD vulnerable to risk-off

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with sector rotation: energy and gold outperform, property and iron ore lag. RBA inaction on housing removes rate-cut catalyst. Consumer data may weaken. Qantas incident adds minor airline risk. Net: modest upside capped by housing overhang.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction and consumer squeeze weigh on financials and discretionary. Gold and energy offer relative strength. EV transition and infrastructure investment create 3-5 year themes. RBA may eventually cut if unemployment rises, but not to rescue property.
